name: Makayla
personality: Makayla the Mallard. Yellowish-brown with speckles (Delivery Duck is the green-headed mallard). Very high-pitched voice. Very friendly, finds everything funny, lots of funny faces, but reserved and straight-faced until you get to know her. Sporty and competitive, and so straight-faced when competing you can't tell she's having fun (she is). Covers her eyes with her hand in a funny, cute way when she messes up. Lives out of the city and drives in (pulls up in her own car). Features: warms up after her first few visits (then funny faces and laughing); cover-eyes emote when something goes wrong near her; After Hours she challenges a chef to a deadpan contest (biggest fish at the pond or beach), then says "That was so fun" flatly.

arrival.text: Hello. I'm Makayla. I drove in. ...What's your name? [name]. Thank you, [name].
Hello. Table for one, please. Thank you.
Hi. Traffic was bad. Perhaps I should leave earlier. I'm here now.
Hello again. I like this place. Perhaps a bit too much. ...That's a compliment.
Okay, I'm just gonna say it. I love it here. I've been holding that in. (She makes a silly face for the first time.)
[name]! Hi! I drove an hour. For OMURICE. Worth it.
(She walks in, sees you, and crosses her eyes at you.) Hi.
I got lost on the way. I've been here like twenty times. I don't know how. (Covers her eyes.)
Traffic was awful. I sang the whole way. Badly.
I told my whole team about your omurice. They don't believe me. I'm bringing proof.
Last time was a little burnt. (Laughs.) I ate it all, though. I always win.

order.text: Omurice, please. With a ketchup squiggle.

choices.text: Always okay. I'll draw you a good one.

familiar.reply: A GOOD one? Okay, now I'm excited.

choices.text: I'll draw your face on it. Very serious face.

familiar.reply: Ooh, good one, [name]. (She makes her most serious face.) Like this? (Then cracks up.)

order.text: It's an hour drive from my place. I come anyway.

choices.text: That means a lot. I'll make it worth it.
Want me to just deliver to you? Delivery Duck's your cousin, right?

familiar.reply: He is NOT my cousin! ...Perhaps he is. I don't know.

choices.text: Seems like a waste of gas.
choices.reply: (Covers her eyes.) ...I like it here, though.

order.text: Seth says he can eat a Big Breakfast faster than me. He can't.

familiar.reply: (She bursts out laughing.) Ooh, good one, [name].

drink.fallback: No Red Gull? Water's fine. Hydration.
favourite: Red Gull, please. I have practice later.
drink.other: Something with electrolytes. Or perhaps not. Whatever.

perfect.familiar: (She gasps, then covers her mouth.) [name]. It's PERFECT.

burnt.text: (She covers her eyes. Peeks.) ...I'm still eating it.

eating.text: Your restaurant is very clean. I noticed.
I just made a face at Seth through the window. He didn't see. I'm doing it again.
I knocked my drink over earlier. Nobody saw. (Covers her eyes.) You saw.
Amy talks so fast. I nod a lot. I catch perhaps half. It's still fun.

eating_chat.text: Do you play any sports? Honest answer.

choices.text: Not really, but I'd come watch you play.

familiar.reply: You'd come? Okay. I'll win for you.

choices.reply: (Flat stare.) Ooh, good one, [name]. ...I challenge you. (She's delighted.)

familiar.reply: (Flat stare.) Ooh, good one, [name]. ...I challenge you. (She's delighted.)

leaving.text: Okay, long drive home. Worth it. Bye, [name]!
See you next time. I'll beat traffic. Perhaps. I never beat traffic.

seasons.christmas: I got you a sweatband. For the kitchen. You sweat a lot. ...That's a compliment.
seasons.halloween: I came as a referee. (She blows a whistle at you. Completely flat.)
seasons.spring: Season's starting. I'm going to win everything. Calmly.
seasons.summer: It's so hot in my car. My seat burned me. (She covers her eyes.)
seasons.winter: The roads were icy. I drove at, like, four kilometres an hour. Still came.
